title: querylog.py reredact holds the distill lock while it rewrites run files, so a concurrent apply never reads a half-written file
goal: querylog.py reredact takes the distill lock before its backup and releases it after its last write, and says so and exits 3 when another distill or apply holds it, as apply --push does; kb/_self/querylog.md names it

run:
import sys, inspect
sys.path.insert(0, "_tools")
import ql_store
src = inspect.getsource(ql_store.reredact)
assert "acquire" in src and "release" in src, "reredact rewrites run files without the distill lock apply --push holds"
